guides.title: Consumer prices
guides.blurb: The cost of an ordinary shopping basket, measured monthly. The RBI's target, your salary's adversary, and the most argued-about number in Indian economics.
guides.what: consumer price inflation, year on year

guides.title: GDP
guides.blurb: The size and speed of the whole economy, estimated quarterly: what growth is made of, from consumption to investment and government, and what the aggregate hides.
guides.what: real GDP growth, year on year

guides.title: Wholesale prices
guides.blurb: Factory-gate prices, a different basket from the CPI that measures a different thing. Why the two often part ways, and why both can be right.
guides.what: wholesale price inflation, year on year

guides.title: Industrial production
guides.blurb: The monthly pulse of mining, manufacturing and electricity. Volatile, revised, and read far too literally.
guides.what: industrial output growth, year on year

guides.title: External account
guides.blurb: India's account with the world: the current account, foreign money in and out, reserves week by week, the rupee against a basket, external debt, and the money families send and receive.
guides.what: current account balance, the quarter's surplus (+) or deficit (−)

guides.title: Jobs
guides.blurb: Who has work, who wants it, and who is counted. India's jobs number is not a count of jobs; it is three surveys, timed three ways, kept side by side.
guides.what: unemployment rate, age 15 and over

guides.title: Household spending
guides.blurb: The household budget of a country, averaged: what a person spends in a month, rung by rung of the ladder, and why the average is nobody's life.
guides.what: rural spending per person per month

guides.title: Factories and enterprises
guides.blurb: The factory, the shop and the line between them. Registered factories audited to the last rupee, and informal firms counted only since 2021, side by side and never summed.
guides.what: factories in operation

guides.title: Higher education
guides.blurb: Who enrols in college, who is left out, and what the Gross Enrolment Ratio really measures, across five rounds of the national survey.
guides.what: students enrolled in higher education

guides.title: Women and men
guides.blurb: How many girls are born, how long women live, how far they study, whether they work and what they earn, who holds money, a seat or a judgeship, and how safe women are: every table of MoSPI's Women and Men in India, each kept to its own source.
guides.what: girls born for every 1,000 boys (Sample Registration System)

guides.title: Renewable energy
guides.blurb: India's renewable capacity, month by month: solar, wind, hydro and bio, including the month the total jumped because a definition changed.
guides.what: renewable power capacity installed

guides.title: Family health
guides.blurb: How healthy Indian families are, state by state, village and town: anaemia, children's growth and vaccines, births, blood pressure and blood sugar, cancer screening, women's money and safety, tobacco and alcohol, across two national surveys.
guides.what: children aged 6 to 59 months with anaemia

guides.title: Manufacturing
guides.blurb: India's manufacturing since 1960: the share of GDP that never took off, the slow climb toward high technology, and what factories sell abroad. Measured by the World Bank, not MoSPI.
guides.what: manufacturing's share of GDP

guides.title: Where Indians keep their money
guides.blurb: How much Indian households hold in savings accounts and fixed deposits, what interest those deposits earn, how long they are locked away, and who holds them.
guides.what: households' bank deposits

guides.title: How much India owes
guides.blurb: What India's households, companies and government owe, as a share of the economy; the credit gap central banks watch for booms; how much income goes on repayments; and how India compares with China, the US and its peers.
guides.what: debt of households, companies and government, % of GDP (BIS estimate)

guides.title: House prices
guides.blurb: Whether homes are getting dearer faster than everything else, which cities rose most, and why three official measures of house prices tell slightly different stories.
guides.what: real house prices, change on a year ago

guides.title: Services
guides.blurb: The shop, the bus, the bank, the clinic and the software firm: how big India's services are, which are growing, what India sells to the world, and who does the work.
guides.what: services' share of gross value added

guides.title: State economies
guides.blurb: How big each state's economy is, how fast it grows, how much it produces per person, and what it runs on: farms, factories or services. From Sikkim and Goa to Bihar.
guides.what: income per person, richest state against poorest

guides.title: Poverty and inequality
guides.blurb: The share of Indians living below the World Bank's international poverty lines, from every consumption survey since 1977-78: what each line means in rupees, why the numbers people quote differ, and what a decade without a survey did to what we know.
guides.what: of Indians below $3.00 a day (2021 PPP)

guides.title: Population
guides.blurb: India's population since 1950 and the UN's projections to 2100: how old the country is, when its working-age share peaks, how fast fertility fell, how long people live, and how fast its cities grow.
guides.what: people in India, UN estimate

guides.title: Climate and heat
guides.blurb: A century of Indian temperature and rain, the heat people actually live through, what India emits against China, the US and the world, and what the climate models project for a child born today.
guides.what: India's temperature against the 1991-2020 average for the month

guides.title: Work, as the ILO counts it
guides.blurb: How many Indians work, why so few women are counted at work, how many young people are neither working nor studying, and how India compares with China, Bangladesh, Indonesia and Vietnam, on the ILO's common definitions.
guides.what: women aged 15+ in the labour force, ILO estimate

guides.title: Interest rates
guides.blurb: What the RBI decides and why, every MPC vote since 2016, and how a change in the repo rate reaches your home loan, your fixed deposit and the government's borrowing.
guides.what: the RBI's policy repo rate

guides.title: Bank credit and money
guides.blurb: Who borrows from India's banks, from farmers and factories to home buyers and gold-loan takers; how fast credit and money grow; where the loans go, state by state; and how the bad-loan cycle of 2015 to 2020 was cleaned up.
guides.what: growth of bank credit, year on year

guides.title: What India buys and sells
guides.blurb: Every shipment that crosses India's customs border, counted each month: what the country sells and buys, from crude oil and gold to phones and rice, and with whom.
guides.what: merchandise trade balance (exports minus imports)

guides.title: How Indians pay
guides.blurb: UPI, cards, NEFT, RTGS, cheques, ATMs and the e-rupee: how many payments Indians make each month, how big they are, and whether cash and cards are giving way.
guides.what: UPI payments made in the month

guides.title: What India grows
guides.blurb: How much rice, wheat, pulses, oilseeds, sugarcane and cotton India grows, how much a hectare yields, which states grow what, the support prices the government sets, and the grain it buys and stores.
guides.what: foodgrains harvested in the crop year (final estimate)

guides.title: India's banks
guides.blurb: Which banks hold India's money and lend it, how public and private banks traded places, which are healthiest and most profitable, how the bad-loan cycle of 2015 to 2020 was cleaned up, and the co-operative banks, NBFCs and development banks beside them.
guides.what: banks' bad loans, gross NPAs as a share of gross advances

guides.title: Government budgets and debt
guides.blurb: What India's governments earn, spend, borrow and owe: the Centre's deficit month by month, every budget against what it delivered, how much of each rupee goes to interest, who lends to the government, and which states are stretched.
guides.what: the Centre's fiscal deficit so far this year, as a share of the year's budget estimate

guides.title: Savings, markets and companies
guides.blurb: Where households put their money beyond the bank, from provident funds and insurance to mutual funds, shares and gold; how companies raise it from markets; how listed and unlisted companies are doing; and what professional forecasters expect.
guides.what: households' net financial saving, share of the quarter's GDP

guides.title: School education
guides.blurb: School access, teachers, progression, facilities and the costs families bear, across every published UDISE and CMSE cut.
guides.what: students enrolled in recognised schools, including school pre-primary

guides.title: Household assets and borrowing
guides.blurb: Land, homes, financial assets, valuables, creditors, loan terms and investment in the AIDIS household survey.
guides.what: mean assets per rural household, historical snapshot

guides.title: Farm households
guides.blurb: Income, paid-out and imputed costs, land, tenure, animals, creditors, crop sales, inputs and risk in the rural household survey.
guides.what: mean monthly agricultural-household income, historical survey
guides.period: July 2018–June 2019; seasonal/visit references in each cell

guides.title: Energy
guides.blurb: Where energy comes from, where it goes, and how India produces electricity.
guides.what: total primary energy supply

guides.title: Digital access
guides.blurb: Internet at home, phone use and ownership, digital tasks, banking and online purchases, with the published age, gender, rural/urban and state cuts.
guides.what: households with internet within their premises

guides.title: Pensions
guides.blurb: PFRDA subscriber stocks, scheme assets and administrative records, with separate expected schedules and a complete source review register.
guides.what: APY subscribers, published stock
